sources.title: Sufood 2023 regular menu, 14 pages

sources.title: Sufood historical CNY2024 Yu Sheng and food choices, three pages
sources.notes: Created and modified 11 January 2024; all three pages visually checked. Page 2 terms date Yu Sheng 19 January-24 February 2024, while an opening-hours sentence incorrectly prints 11 February 2023. Page 3 set dates are 9-24 February 2024; keep the printed conflict explicit. Packages with cider/beverages excluded.
